title: Weakspot Research Environment
text: An interactive application for studying weakspots of regression models: configure an experiment, run it, and inspect the detected weakspots and error landscapes, with a companion page that aggregates the results of each sweep.
features: Weakspot identification with standard detectors and structured ensembles
Data-selective training guided by detected weakspots
Iterated selection over rounds of retraining
note: The code will be released once the papers under review are decided.

title: Online demonstrator
text: A hosted version of the environment that runs in the browser without installation, for exploring weakspots on example problems.
